author: nickyeow

english.text: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.

jyutping: go3 caan1 paai2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 zung2 leoi6 ge3 coi3 sik1。
text: 個餐牌有好多唔同種類嘅菜色。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I made a paper plane.

jyutping: ngo5 zip3 zo2 zek3 zi2 fei1 gei1。
text: 我摺咗隻紙飛機。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I often used to play tennis with him on Sundays.

jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 sing1 kei4 jat6 seng4 jat6 tung4 keoi5 heoi3 daa2 mong5 kau4。
text: 我以前星期日成日同佢去打網球。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I hear he's just begun looking for another job.

jyutping: teng1 gong2 keoi5 jau6 hoi1 ci2 wan2 gung1 lo1 wo3。
text: 聽講佢又開始搵工囉喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Next week I'm going to Vancouver to visit my sister.

jyutping: haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 ngo5 heoi3 wan1 go1 waa4 taam3 ngo5 go3 sai3 mui2。
text: 下個禮拜我去溫哥華探我個細妹。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let's let the workers go home early today.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 bei2 baan1 fo2 gei3 zou2 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1。
text: 我哋今日俾班伙記早啲返屋企啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He thinks he knows everything.

jyutping: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 me1 dou1 sik1。
text: 佢以為自己咩都識。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What do you study a foreign language for?

jyutping: nei5 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 hok6 ngoi6 jyu5 aa3？
text: 你點解要學外語呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't really know why, but they don't like me.

jyutping: ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 ngo5。
text: 我都唔知點解，但係佢哋唔係好鍾意我。

author: fercheung

english.text: Tom doesn't know when Mary will leave Boston.

jyutping: aa3 Tom m4 zi1 Mary gei2 si4 wui5 lei4 hoi1 bo1 si6 deon2。
text: 阿Tom唔知Mary幾時會離開波士頓。

author: kaenif

english.text: I'm bursting for a wee and I can't find a washroom.

jyutping: ngo5 zau6 gap1 dou3 laai6，daan6 hai6 wan2 m4 dou3 ci3 so2。
text: 我就急到賴，但係搵唔到廁所。

author: nickyeow

english.text: His explanation is not clear.

jyutping: keoi5 gaai2 sik1 dak1 m4 hai6 hou2 cing1 co2。
text: 佢解釋得唔係好清楚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Give it a shot.

jyutping: si3 haa2 laa1。
text: 試吓啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm blind in the right eye.

jyutping: ngo5 jau6 ngaan5 tai2 m4 dou3 je5。
text: 我右眼睇唔到嘢。

author: clowergen

english.text: My uncle lives in Madrid, the capital of Spain.

jyutping: ngo5 kau5 fu2 zyu6 hai2 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 ge3 sau2 dou1 maa5 dak1 lei5。
text: 我舅父住喺西班牙嘅首都馬德里。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: A Chinese girl from Ipoh who is fluent in Kadazan rather than Cantonese as her native speaker.

jyutping: jat1 wai6 lei4 zi6 ji4 bou2 ge3 waa4 jan4 neoi2，keoi5 ge3 mou5 jyu5 hai6 gwong2 dung1 waa2，ji4 m4 hai6 gwong2 dung1 waa2。
text: 一位嚟自怡保嘅華人女，佢嘅母語係廣東話，而唔係廣東話。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Because he's ill, he can't come.

jyutping: keoi4 bing6 zo2 loi4 m4 dou3。
text: 渠病咗來唔到。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Having thus imparted to you my sentiments, as they have been awakened by the occasion which brings us together, I shall take my present leave; but not without resorting once more to the benign parent of the human race, in humble supplication that since he has been pleased to favour the American people, with opportunities for deliberating in perfect tranquility, and dispositions for deciding with unparalleled unanimity on a form of Government, for the security of their Union, and the advancement of their happiness; so his divine blessing may be equally conspicuous in the enlarged views, the temperate consultations, and the wise measures on which the success of this Government must depend.

jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gam2 joeng2 zoeng1 ngo5 ge3 cing4 gam2 cyun4 dai6 bei2 nei5，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 bei6 ngo5 dei6 zeoi6 zaap6 ge3 gei1 wui6 so2 wun6 sing2，ngo5 wui5 ceng2 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 gaa3 kei4；daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 wui5 zoi3 ci3 hoeng3 jan4 leoi6 ge3 loeng4 sing3 fu6 mou5 kau4 zo6，him1 heoi1 dei6 kei4 kau4，jan1 wai6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 hou2 lok6 ji3 zi1 ci4 mei5 gwok3 jan4 man4，jau5 gei1 wui6 hai2 jyun4 mei5 ge3 ning4 zing6 zung1 sam2 ji5，tung4 maai4 kyut3 ding6 ji5 mou4 jyu5 leon4 bei2 ge3 on1 cyun4 jing4 sik1，wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zing3 fu2，ji5 mou4 jyu5 leon4 bei2 ge3 on1 cyun4 jing4 sik1 zeon3 bou6，wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 hang6 fuk1 ji4 nou5 lik6。so2 ji5 keoi5 ge3 san4 sing3 zuk1 fuk1 ho2 nang4 tung4 joeng6 gam2 hin2 ngaan5，baau1 kut3 kwok3 daai6 ge3 gun1 dim2、wan1 wo4 ge3 hip3 soeng1，tung4 maai4 ni1 go3 zing3 fu2 ge3 sing4 gung1 bit1 seoi1 ji1 laai6 ge3 ming4 zi3 cou3 si1。
text: 我已經噉樣將我嘅情感傳遞畀你，因為佢哋已經被我哋聚集嘅機會所喚醒，我會請我而家嘅假期；但係我唔會再次向人類嘅良性父母求助，謙虛地祈求，因為佢一直好樂意支持美國人民，有機會喺完美嘅寧靜中審議，同埋決定以無與倫比嘅安全形式，為佢哋嘅政府，以無與倫比嘅安全形式進步，為佢哋嘅幸福而努力。所以佢嘅神聖祝福可能同樣咁顯眼，包括擴大嘅觀點、溫和嘅協商，同埋呢個政府嘅成功必須依賴嘅明智措施。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Either the well was very deep, or she fell very slowly, for she had plenty of time as she went down to look about her, and to wonder what was going to happen next. First, she tried to look down and make out what she was coming to, but it was too dark to see anything: then she looked at the sides of the well, and noticed that they were filled with cupboards and book-shelves: here and there she saw maps and pictures hung upon pegs. She took down a jar from one of the shelves as she passed; it was labelled "ORANGE MARMALADE," but to her great disappointment it was empty: she did not like to drop the jar for fear of killing somebody underneath, so managed to put it into one of the cupboards as she fell past it.

jyutping: jat1 hai6 zing2 hou2 sam1，jat1 hai6 keoi5 dit3 dak1 hou2 maan6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 jau5 hou2 do1 si4 gaan1 lok6 heoi3 mong6 haa5 keoi5，tung4 maai4 soeng2 zi1 haa5 jat1 bou6 wui6 faat3 sang1 di1 me1 si6。sau2 sin1，keoi5 si3 tou4 mong6 lok6 heoi3，tai2 haa5 keoi5 lei4 gan2 ge3 dei6 fong1，daan6 hai6 tin1 taai3 hak1，tai2 m4 dou3 jam6 ho4 je5：jin4 hau6 keoi5 mong6 zyu6 zing2 ge3 loeng5 bin1，faat3 jin6 keoi5 dei6 soeng6 min6 zong1 mun5 zo2 gwai6 tung4 syu1 gaa3 soeng6 min6 ge3 soeng1 dong1 keoi5 ging1 gwo3 go2 zan6，go2 go3 soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6「caang2 sik1 gwo2 zoeng3」，daan6 hai6 ling6 keoi5 hou2 sat1 mong6 ge3 hai6，go2 go3 hai6 hung1 ge3：keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 dam1 dai1 go3 gun3，jan1 wai6 keoi5 geng1 wui6 hai2 haa6 min6 saat3 sei2 jan4，so2 ji5 dong1 keoi5 dit3 gwo3 heoi3 go2 zan6，keoi5 sing4 gung1 zoeng1 go3 gun3 fong3 jap6 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 gwai6 dou6。
text: 一係井好深，一係佢跌得好慢，因為佢有好多時間落去望下佢，同埋想知下一步會發生啲咩事。首先，佢試圖望落去，睇吓佢嚟緊嘅地方，但係天太黑，睇唔到任何嘢：然後佢望住井嘅兩邊，發現佢哋上面裝滿咗櫃同書架上面嘅相當佢經過嗰陣，嗰個上面寫住「橙色果醬」，但係令佢好失望嘅係，嗰個係空嘅：佢唔鍾意揼低個罐，因為佢驚會喺下面殺死人，所以當佢跌過去嗰陣，佢成功將個罐放入其中一個櫃度。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Political life, as a whole, is an endless chain consisting of an infinite number of links. The whole art of politics lies in finding and taking as firm a grip as we can of the link that is least likely to be struck from our hands, the one that is most important at the given moment, the one that, most of all, guarantees its possessor the possession of the whole chain.

jyutping: zing3 zi6 sang1 wut6，zok3 wai4 jat1 go3 zing2 tai2，hai6 jat1 tiu4 jau4 mou4 haan6 do1 go3 lin4 git3 zou2 sing4 ge3 mou4 kung4 mou4 zeon6 lin2。zing2 go3 zing3 zi6 ngai6 seot6 zau6 hai6 jiu3 wan2 dou3 tung4 zuk1 zyu6 ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 m4 ho2 nang4 cung4 ngo5 dei6 sau2 zung1 bei6 gik1 lok6 ge3 lin4 git3，zik1 hai6 hai2 dak6 ding6 si4 hak1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 lin4 git3，zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 hai6 bou2 zing3 keoi5 ge3 jung2 jau5 ze2 jung2 jau5 zing2 go3 lin2 ge3 lin4 git3。
text: 政治生活，作為一個整體，係一條由無限多個連結組成嘅無窮無盡鏈。整個政治藝術就係要搵到同捉住我哋最唔可能從我哋手中被擊落嘅連結，即係喺特定時刻最重要嘅連結，最重要嘅係保證佢嘅擁有者擁有整個鏈嘅連結。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I woke up early today. I started my café-hopping here on Lulu Island just after 5 in the night-like morning. I walked to Tim Hortons to have a Green Tea with Oat Milk and a Sausage Egg Cheese English Muffin. Pushpak the South Asian vendor was not there today. I was the only customer in the vast chamber. Then, I walked to Starbucks. My baristas were Nicole the Filipina and Jessica the Vietnamese. I was drinking a Brown Sugar Oat Cortado that comes in a cute, little ceramic mug. It tasted like jackfruit to me. Jessica from afar whispered loudly and solemnly, "Richmond is not like Asia." A regular, a big white man with white hair, sat with his tablet computer at a table near the washrooms. I thought that he was playing games on it. It was the 23rd of January of 2025.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jat1 zou2 hei2 san1，hai2 je6 maan5 ng5 dim2 gei2 zi1 hau6，ngo5 hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2 hoi1 ci2 zo2 ngo5 ge3 gaa3 fe1 teng1。ngo5 haang4 heoi3 Tim Hortons sik6 zo2 go3 luk6 caa4 pui3 jin3 mak6 naai5 tung4 go3 hoeng1 coeng2 daan2 zi1 si2 jing1 sik1 sung1 beng2，go3 naam4 aa3 siu2 faan2 gam1 jat6 mou5 hai2 dou6，jin4 hau6，ngo5 haang4 heoi3 sing1 baa1 hak1。ngo5 ge3 gaa3 fe1 si1 hai6 fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4 nei4 ho2 tung4 jyut6 naam4 jan4 git6 sai1 kaa1。ngo5 jam2 gan2 jat1 bui1 hung4 tong4 jin3 mak6 fo1 taap3 do1，keoi5 hai2 go3 ho2 oi3 ge3 siu2 tou4 ci4 bui1 jap6 min6，deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hou2 ci5 ngau4 jau4 gwo2 gam2，git6 sai1 kaa1 hai2 jyun5 cyu3 daai6 seng1 tung4 jim4 suk1 gam2 sai3 sai3 seng1 gong2：「lei5 si6 mun5 m4 ci5 aa3 zau1，jat1 go3 baak6 tau4 faat3 ge3 daai6 baak6 jan4，zo6 hai2 sai2 sau2 gaan1 fu6 gan6 ge3 toi2 dou6，ling1 zyu6 bou6 ping4 baan2 din6 nou5 waan2 gan2 jau4 hei3。」go2 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 1 jyut6 23 hou6。
text: 我今日一早起身，喺夜晚五點幾之後，我喺露露島開始咗我嘅咖啡廳。我行去 Tim Hortons 食咗個綠茶配燕麥奶同個香腸蛋芝士英式鬆餅，個南亞小販今日冇喺度，然後，我行去星巴克。我嘅咖啡師係菲律賓人妮可同越南人杰西卡。我飲緊一杯紅糖燕麥科塔多，佢喺個可愛嘅小陶瓷杯入面，對我嚟講好似牛油果噉，杰西卡喺遠處大聲同嚴肅噉細細聲講：「里士滿唔似亞洲，一個白頭髮嘅大白人，坐喺洗手間附近嘅枱度，拎住部平板電腦玩緊遊戲。」嗰日係2025年1月23號。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A Japanoid told me the other day that talking to you is like a fun video game. Today's the 3rd of May of 2025. Walking, I went before 8 in the morning to Starbucks café, there to enjoy a Lavender Oat Latte. I talked with the café manager, Liz, who is partly Kwakiutl First Nations. She wore a black T-shirt with the words "INDIGENOUS PARTNER NETWORK" on the back. Iryl the Filipino and Chelsea the Mandarin were the baristas. I talked there to the customer Alex, the owner of a power wash company. Apparently, he is a neighbour and lives in a family house built in the 1950s. He doesn't have a girlfriend and wishes to travel more whilst unattached. Alex is Dutch-English. Marlin the Filipina was sitting, reading, at an another table. Dennis the Chinese-German hybrid was at another table. Al the Anglo was at the bar. Later, at Tim Hortons café, I was drinking an Earl Grey tea with oat milk. The baristas were Rajvinder and Pushpak, both Punjabis.

jyutping: kam4 jat6 jau5 go3 Japaneseoid tung4 ngo5 gong2，tung4 nei5 king1 gai2 zau6 hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 hou2 waan2 ge3 din6 zi2 jau4 hei3 gam2。gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 3 hou6。haang4 gan2 lou6，ngo5 hai2 ziu1 zou2 8 dim2 cin4 heoi3 zo2 sing1 baa1 hak1 gaa3 fe1 gun2，hai2 go2 dou6 hoeng2 jung6 zo2 go3 fan1 ji1 cou2 jin3 mak6 naa4 tit3。ngo5 tung4 gaa3 fe1 teng1 ging1 lei5 Liz king1 gwo3 gai3，keoi5 jau5 bou6 fan6 hai6 Kwakiutl jyun4 zyu6 man4。keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 hak1 sik1 T seot1，bui3 min6 se2 zyu6「jyun4 zyu6 man4 hap6 zok3 fo2 bun6 mong5 lok6」。fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4 Iryl tung4 zung1 gwok3 jan4 Chelsea hai6 gaa3 fe1 si1，ngo5 hai2 go2 dou6 tung4 go3 haak3 Alex king1 gwo3 gai3，keoi5 hai6 jat1 gaan1 sai2 din6 gung1 si1 ge3 lou5 baan2。geoi3 gong2，keoi5 hai6 leon4 geoi1，zyu6 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gin3 jyu1 1950 nin4 doi6 ge3 gaa1 ting4 uk1。keoi5 mou5 neoi5 pang4 jau5，hei1 mong6 hai2 mou5 zo2 gwaan1 hai6 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6 heoi3 do1 di1 leoi5 hang4。 Alex hai6 ho4 laan1 jing1 man2。fei1 leot6 ban1 maa5 lam4 zo6 hai2 ling6 jat1 zoeng1 toi2 dou6，tai2 gan2 syu1。zung1 dak1 wan6 hyut3 ji4 daan1 nei4 si1 hai2 ling6 jat1 zoeng1 toi2 dou6。jing1 gaak3 laan4 jan4 aa3 ji5 hai2 zau2 baa1。hau6 loi4，hai2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1，ngo5 jam2 gan2 jat1 bui1 gaa1 zo2 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 baak3 zoek3 caa4。gaa3 fe1 si1 hai6 Rajvinder tung4 Pushpak ，loeng5 go3 dou1 hai6 pong4 ze1 pou2 jan4。
text: 琴日有個 Japaneseoid 同我講，同你傾偈就好似一個好玩嘅電子遊戲噉。今日係2025年5月3號。行緊路，我喺朝早8點前去咗星巴克咖啡館，喺嗰度享用咗個薰衣草燕麥拿鐵。我同咖啡廳經理 Liz 傾過計，佢有部分係 Kwakiutl 原住民。佢着咗件黑色 T 恤，背面寫住「原住民合作夥伴網絡」。菲律賓人 Iryl 同中國人Chelsea係咖啡師，我喺嗰度同個客 Alex 傾過計，佢係一間洗電公司嘅老闆。據講，佢係鄰居，住喺一間建於1950年代嘅家庭屋。佢冇女朋友，希望喺冇咗關係嘅情況下去多啲旅行。 Alex 係荷蘭英文。菲律賓馬林坐喺另一張枱度，睇緊書。中德混血兒丹尼斯喺另一張枱度。英格蘭人阿爾喺酒吧。後來，喺 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳，我飲緊一杯加咗燕麥奶嘅伯爵茶。咖啡師係 Rajvinder 同 Pushpak ，兩個都係旁遮普人。
